value.rationale: The unknown-reset-law identifiability and every-window variance optimum are motivated by inference and precision of non-Poisson reset protocols. The result sharpens known one-time stationary-variance extremization to the complete time-average fluctuation profile, quantifies a factor-six long-time Poisson penalty, and identifies a natural third-moment phase boundary that differs from the previously known second-moment stationary threshold.
